metadata.description: Measured code quality for existing codebases, stack-agnostic: a constraint engine that derives its scope from the constraints themselves, plus an onboarding layer that derives every rule from the project's own code.

plugins.name: luciole
plugins.description: Turn a codebase's unwritten conventions into checks: onboarding derives measured constraint files from the project's own code, verification checks every change against them, and a retrospective keeps them honest. Language-agnostic.
